# METRICS — every live number, measured once

**Status:** current · **Type:** generated · **Updated:** 2026-08-10 · **Owner:** brian
**Generated:** 2026-08-10 · **Source:** the tree itself · **Regenerate:** `bin/generate-metrics`

## Purpose

Every live number in Mente OS, measured once, so no document has to copy one into its prose.

> ⭐ **Why this file exists** (Brian, 2026-07-31): *"que sea un apuntador... no podemos depender
> de que actualices, porque se te puede ir."*
>
> A number copied into prose is correct **exactly once**. `RETOMAR.md` claimed the battery was
> 105/105 when it was 104; `SKILL.md`, written hours after that was fixed, froze 105 again — it
> was already 118. **The fix is not more discipline. It is removing the copy.**

## How to cite a metric

```
⛔  "the battery is 118/118"
✅  "the battery is green — count in `docs/METRICS.md` (battery.checks)"
```

⚠️ **Dated historical evidence does NOT belong here.** *"5 of 11 sessions were never registered
(2026-07-27)"* measures a moment and must never change. Freezing that is correct. Freezing live
state is the bug this file removes.

## battery

|---|---|
| `battery.checks` | **220** |
| `battery.failed` | **0** |

⚠️ **`battery.checks` is not stable across a `/clear`.** The battery includes
`check-clear-ready`, which measures the **live** session: it reads one short until this session
is registered in `Cerebro/Registro_Conversaciones.md`. A count one under the total right after a
`/clear` is **expected, not a regression**.
